definitions.explanation: The state of the atmosphere at a particular time and place.

examples.english: The weather is nice, isn't it?

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{天気|てんき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{天気|てんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{出|で}かけたくない→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The weather is bad, so I don't want to go out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気予報|てんきよほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天気|てんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦そうです→そうです：03098_soudesu⟧。⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}べます→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: According to the weather forecast, the weather will be good this week. We can play outside.

notes:
{天気|てんき} is the common word for weather in daily conversation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- いい{天気|てんき}: nice/good weather
- {悪|わる}い{天気|てんき}: bad weather
- {天気|てんき}がいい/{悪|わる}い: the weather is good/bad
- {天気|てんき}が{崩|くず}れる: weather worsens

RELATED TERMS:
- {天気予報|てんきよほう}: weather forecast
- {天候|てんこう}: weather (more formal)
- {気象|きしょう}: meteorology, weather conditions

WEATHER TYPES:
- {晴|は}れ: sunny
- {曇|くも}り: cloudy
- {雨|あめ}: rain
- {雪|ゆき}: snow
